project_type: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS 4 SPA with Node.js WebSocket server (index.mjs)
build_system: Vite 7 + tsc; build runs tsc -b first then vite build. No monorepo — single package.json at root.
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner via `node --test`; tests in scripts/*.test.mjs
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` from workspace root — must exit 0 with no TS errors. 2. Run `node --test scripts/audit.test.mjs` — all tests pass. 3. For runtime checks, start server with `node server/index.mjs` and open the dev build.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Do NOT restart any running dev server. All file paths must be absolute when used in prompts. The workspace root is c:\Users\pedro\Desktop\dc.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Keep changes minimal and non-breaking. Never modify dist/. Never push — commit locally only.
key_patterns: UI uses shadcn/ui components from src/components/ui/. Custom StyledSelect wrapper at src/components/StyledSelect.tsx wraps shadcn Select. All dialogs use src/components/ui/dialog.tsx (z-[200]/z-[201]). AlertDialog uses z-[230]. Settings page is fixed inset-0 z-[80]. Server rail z-30. Sidebar is fixed z-[60] on mobile. Framer-motion used for animations. api.ts is the WebSocket client. Community type in src/types.ts. Server persists to server/data.json.
directory_structure: src/sections/ — full page views (AuthForm, Sidebar, ServerRail, CallStage, SettingsPage, ChatPanel, AdminPanel, PublicServersView, CallOverlay). src/components/ — reusable components including ServerSettingsDialog, CallSettingsDialog, StyledSelect. src/components/ui/ — shadcn primitives. src/hooks/ — use-chat.ts (main state + WebRTC), use-mobile.ts, use-speaking-users.ts. src/lib/ — api.ts, audio-settings, call-volume, preferences, profile-images, server-names, settings-sections, share-settings, theme-accent, utils. src/types.ts — all shared TypeScript interfaces. server/index.mjs — single-file Node.js WebSocket + HTTP server.
